name: What's the difference between PEX and copper pipes for kitchen plumbing?
description: Copper is durable and long-lasting but more costly; PEX is flexible, easier to install, and more affordable, with good freeze resistance.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between PEX and copper pipes for kitchen plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: PEX and copper are common choices for kitchen plumbing. Copper pipes are durable, resistant to corrosion, and have a long lifespan, but they can be more expensive to install and are susceptible to bursting in freezing temperatures. PEX tubing is flexible, easier and faster to install, and less prone to bursting from freezing. It's also more affordable than copper. While PEX has gained popularity, some prefer copper for its traditional aesthetic and proven track record. Your choice depends on budget, water quality, and specific application.
acceptedAnswer.description: Copper is durable and long-lasting but more costly; PEX is flexible, easier to install, and more affordable, with good freeze resistance.
